processing.loopStartRationale: start chosen so the 6s before the wrap and the 6s after it sit at the same level at P=199s; trimming from 0 put a fade-in against a settled tail

notes: Assembled, not found: clips 13, 25 placed at 42s, 147s in a 232s otherwise-silent track by tools/build-sparse-event-layer.py, low-passed at 600 Hz so it is rumble only with no sharp cracks, then a single fixed gain to -25.0 LUFS — loudnorm pumps on a track that is mostly silence. Same recipe as monsoon/thunder-rumble, different clips. A closed-door recording is the right timbre for a scene heard from inside a sealed sleeper cabin. Seamless-looped to 199s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless. Encoded as Opus (128k) — see DECISIONS.md 'Ship scene audio as Opus, not MP3'.
